FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: Friday, August 14, 2026

ADVANCE MONTHLY SALES FOR RETAIL AND FOOD SERVICES, JULY 2026

Advance estimates of U.S. retail and food services sales for July 2026, adjusted for seasonal variation and holiday and trading-day differences, but not for price changes, were $763.6 billion, down 0.6 percent from the previous month, but up 5.0 percent from July 2025.
